entries.775fdf1bb42d07ce: This business develops, distributes and operates games for smartphones and tablets, and also sells character goods and drama CDs and voice CDs. According to the securities report, the games can be enjoyed while communicating with multiple people; the games themselves are provided free of charge, and revenue is earned by having users purchase in-game items and the like, a business model known as "freemium." Net sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥9,313 million, the largest of the three reportable segments. The operating loss was ¥21 million, narrowed from an operating loss of ¥390 million in the previous fiscal year. The securities report explains that although sales of content and goods are on a recovery trend, results came in slightly below expectations, leading to a decrease in net sales and an operating loss. The major customers listed are Apple Inc. (¥2,778 million) and Google Inc. (¥1,870 million), and the securities report notes that these two companies are payment agents that collect payments from users on the company's behalf.

entries.c223866c2261bbdd: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the company's group (the company, 27 consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate) conducts its business through three [[term:segment|reportable segments]]. The Content Business provides games free of charge for smartphones and tablets, earning revenue through a business model called “freemium”, in which users buy in-game items, and it also sells character goods and other items. The Asset Management Business centers on small-scale, short-term income-producing real estate, and engages in real estate sales and leasing, planning and operation of accommodation facilities, and investment in companies in Japan and overseas, among other activities. The ＩＴ Services Business is responsible for an affiliate platform specialized in online electronic publishing and data services such as managed hosting. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥16,472 million, of which the Content Business accounted for ¥9,313 million, the Asset Management Business for ¥5,469 million, and the ＩＴ Services Business for ¥1,689 million.

entries.f703581f2cc198ca: This business conducts real estate business, rental management, planning, operation, management and running of accommodation facilities and related consulting, and investment in companies in Japan and overseas. Net sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥5,469 million, and operating profit was ¥591 million. The securities report explains that although net sales decreased due to delays in the completion of investment real estate held for sale and other factors, sales of investment real estate, which has a relatively high profit margin, were strong, and operating profit increased. As for how the business is conducted, it states that the company focuses on small-scale income-producing real estate with short business periods and operates cautiously while watching the lending stance of financial institutions and other factors.
